system.description:
Cunei Myrgha Inheritance: a business. Uncommon, Air. No item slots.

Prerequisites: Society:Legalism[1], Society:Cunei[1], Proficiency[3]

You are a dedicated civil servant acquainted with mail services

Influential (Ceremony): Every Long Rest that you take in your home city, you must spend at least one Long Rest action working for the Ministry. When you do, choose one effect:
Take Pay: Gain 50gp
Gain Lead: Gain 1 lead related to a hint or plot point actively on-going in your campaign by reading the mail

Rulebook p.45.
